def: forcible; collectively and concretely, an army

occurrences.text: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
